assist.scope: source-addressed downside, execution-risk and falsifier support only; no numeric underwriting or score

claims.claim: Q2 2026 commercialization growth is real but remains economically early: updated Q2 revenue was $13.538M while GAAP operating loss was $29.858M, so present operating economics do not yet demonstrate self-funding scale.

Reported Q2 operating cash generation was distorted by a temporary $27.4M payroll-tax working-capital benefit; issuer disclosure estimated approximately $14M operating cash burn excluding that timing benefit and expected remittance in Q3.

The August revenue update increased Q2 revenue and FY2026 guidance because of revenue-recognition timing changes for two government contracts and stated no change to cash or underlying business fundamentals; this makes cash and contract-level delivery a stronger falsifier than headline guidance alone.

The company had substantial liquidity after the 2026 business combination, but the 10-Q states it has incurred losses and used operating cash since inception; stock-based compensation also materially increased non-cash operating adjustments, making per-share conversion and burn normalization relevant risk evidence rather than present insolvency blockers.

risks: Operating losses remain large relative to current revenue despite strong liquidity.
Temporary working-capital movements can overstate period operating cash generation if not normalized.
Government-contract revenue timing can change reported growth without changing cash or underlying delivery economics.
Stock-based compensation and future capital needs can reduce per-share conversion even if technical progress continues.

contradictions.observed: Rapid revenue growth and a strong post-transaction liquidity position coexist with operating losses exceeding quarterly revenue.
contradictions.interpretation: Commercial traction and economic self-sufficiency are different milestones; this is a real stage-of-commercialization tension, not evidence that commercialization is absent.
contradictions.falsifier: Sustained gross-profit expansion plus normalized operating cash improvement would weaken this concern.

contradictions.observed: Revenue guidance increased after an accounting timing adjustment while cash and underlying business fundamentals were stated unchanged.
contradictions.interpretation: Headline revenue acceleration should be corroborated with cash collections, contract delivery and repeat customer economics.
contradictions.falsifier: Subsequent contract cash realization and recurring commercial deployments consistent with recognized revenue would reduce the accounting-quality concern.

unknowns: Customer concentration and normalized gross-margin durability remain Alpha-owned underwriting questions.
The rate at which current liquidity converts into repeat commercial quantum revenue remains unproven.
Future stock-based compensation and any additional financing requirements remain uncertain.

gatingStatus.nextLawfulPath: Council Alpha may source-address and quantify these risks under Methodology 1.0 without treating Beta's qualitative evidence as a numeric score.

recommendedNextState: retain researching until Alpha closes owned underwriting/risk evidence gates
